_meta.description: CEN-CENELEC JTC 21 standards developed to support EU AI Act conformity (Art. 40 harmonised standards) plus their current standardisation status. Researched live, not pre-baked — see source_url per row. As of this research date, no JTC 21 deliverable has been cited in the Official Journal of the EU (OJEU), so none currently grants a legal presumption of conformity; 'harmonised' below is reserved for that future state. Every row is needs_founder_review=true: this is compliance-facing content and none of it has been confirmed by a human reviewer.

status_definitions.harmonised: Reference cited in the OJEU under the AI Act — grants legal presumption of conformity. None as of researched_at.
status_definitions.published: CEN/CENELEC has approved and published the definitive EN text, but it has not yet been cited in the OJEU.
status_definitions.draft: Still a prEN under development (drafting, enquiry, or formal-vote stage) — not yet a published EN.

standards.title: Artificial intelligence — Quality management system for EU AI Act regulatory purposes
standards.notes: CEN distributed the definitive EN 18286:2026 text 22 Jul 2026 (first published JTC 21 deliverable). CEN's own announcement calls it 'the first harmonized European standard for the AI Act' — that is CEN's generic EN/national-adoption sense of 'harmonized', not the AI Act Art. 40 legal term; no OJEU citation has been found, so status is recorded as published, not harmonised. CEN members must adopt nationally by 2027-01-31.
